note: The agent roster. Each agent: its own config (agents/<id>/, core in config/), its own state (state/agents/<id>/, core in state/), its own keys (HL_AGENT_KEY_<ID> secrets; core uses HL_AGENT_KEY), its own pot and kill switch. The dashboard lists them in this order.

agents.name: Core
agents.desc: Trades 12–14 big coins every 4 hours when the bigger trend and Bitcoin agree. The original rules: the best backtest, the fewest trades.

agents.name: Wide
agents.desc: Trades 31 liquid coins every 4 hours when the bigger trend agrees, without the Bitcoin check. About 1.7× Core's trades, a smaller edge.

agents.name: Fast
agents.desc: Trades 31 coins every hour when the bigger trend agrees. No proven edge yet, so paper only.

agents.name: Trend
agents.desc: Holds Bitcoin and Ether while each is above its 50-day average, sized to their swings, checked daily. Judged over a year.

agents.name: Carry
agents.desc: Earns funding while staying price-neutral (short perp, long spot). Paper until a testnet run validates it; to scale, it must keep at least 80% of the funding it should earn.

agents.name: A01 Rotation
agents.desc: Holds the 3 strongest of 13 coins in a bull market, re-ranked weekly. Picked by the AiFi Lab (recipe rot-e335df0b); paper, and dropped if it stops matching its backtest.

agents.name: A02 Bull
agents.desc: While at least two of three bull signals agree, holds the 3 of 35 coins with the strongest move beyond Bitcoin's over 30 days, re-ranked every 7 days; all cash when the bull signal ends. Picked by the AiFi Lab (recipe bm-c3067ed4); paper, and dropped if it stops matching its backtest.
